proofBoundaries: Contracts cover the stated pure transitions, not a universal theorem of the complete ECS simulation or every gameplay recipe/achievement/statistic.
Universal ASCII encode/decode roundtrip is not proved; protocol laws cover canonical-number admission and bounded refusal. Wire encoding was unchanged.
Arbitrary Patricia lookup correctness and unique allocation cardinality are not proved; the full plan obeys its ordered specification and result keys come from permitted free sources.
Whole pickup conserves its natural value; U32 merges/wallet arithmetic retain machine wrap semantics. Full death-to-pool-to-player Nat conservation is not claimed.
Music laws pin arrangement/transport decisions and voice budgets; every note parameter, physical playback deadline and subjective output quality are not universally proved.
Browser record_run consumes completed receipts supplied by its host adapter; exact credit/idempotence laws are not an added terminal-phase validator.
Native UI checks exercise actual event handlers, rendered images and file IO headlessly; opening a physical window and speaker audition were not performed.
Real co-op browser qualification used isolated contexts on one machine with real Iroh relays; arbitrary physical networks and cross-backend floating-point determinism are not proved.
confidenceAssessment: Above the requested engineering-confidence threshold based on independent-kernel proofs, type-correct semantic faults, source-consumer audit and native/browser qualification; not a measured probability or a percentage of all game behavior.
artifacts: Generated binaries, browser profiles, captures and detailed logs remain outside tracked source under /tmp or ignored build directories.
